product_overview: Triplyy is a role-based ride-sharing and carpooling platform for Egypt that lets drivers post rides and passengers discover, book, and manage matching trips. The app also supports groups, recurring rides, loyalty rewards, ratings, and driver wallet tools, with full English and Arabic localization.
core_goals: Sign in and complete onboarding to access the app
Create and manage driver rides, including recurring rides
Discover, book, and track passenger rides
Manage bookings, ratings, loyalty points, and account settings
Create, join, and manage carpool groups, including sponsored groups
Review and use driver wallet features such as top-up, withdrawal, and cash-back redemption

features.name: Login and Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in with email and password or request an OTP-based sign-in flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Request an OTP code -> Enter email address -> Submit the OTP request -> See the OTP verification page
Navigate to /login -> Attempt sign-in with invalid credentials -> See an error message

features.name: OTP Verification
features.description: Lets users complete sign-in by entering the emailed one-time code.
user_flows: Navigate to /otp -> Enter the 6-digit code -> Submit verification -> See the next authenticated page
Navigate to /otp -> Enter an invalid or expired code -> Submit verification -> See an error message
Navigate to /otp -> Request a new code -> Receive a fresh OTP email

features.name: Signup Role Selection
features.description: Lets a newly authenticated user choose whether they will use the app as a driver or passenger.
user_flows: Navigate to /role-select -> Select the Driver role -> Continue to the next onboarding step
Navigate to /role-select -> Select the Passenger role -> Continue to the next onboarding step

features.name: Set Password
features.description: Allows a newly signed-up user to set a local password for future sign-ins.
user_flows: Navigate to /set-password -> Enter a new password -> Confirm the password -> Save the password -> Continue onboarding

features.name: Org Email Verification
features.description: Confirms control of an organization email address so the user can access trusted app functions.
user_flows: Navigate to /verify-org-email -> Enter an organization email address -> Request a verification code -> Enter the received OTP code -> Confirm verification -> Continue into the app

features.name: Sign Out
features.description: Ends the current session and returns the user to the login screen.
user_flows: Navigate to /signout -> Observe the session end -> See the login page

features.name: Profile Onboarding
features.description: Collects the user’s display name, phone number, and date of birth during onboarding.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Enter display name -> Enter phone number -> Enter date of birth -> Save and continue onboarding

features.name: Driver Vehicle Registration
features.description: Lets a driver register the vehicle used for posting rides.
user_flows: Navigate to /driver/register-vehicle -> Enter vehicle make -> Enter vehicle model -> Enter plate number -> Enter color -> Enter seat count -> Register the vehicle -> Continue onboarding

features.name: Role-Aware Dashboard
features.description: Shows a landing page tailored to the user’s role with shortcuts to the main areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View role-specific summary cards -> Open a linked section such as rides, bookings, wallet, or search

features.name: Passenger Ride Search
features.description: Helps passengers discover rides through featured listings and route-based search results.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> View the featured rides list -> Open a featured ride to inspect it
Navigate to /search -> Enter origin and destination -> Submit the search -> View matching ride candidates

features.name: Ride Detail and Booking
features.description: Lets passengers review a ride, choose seats, confirm a booking, and view live tracking for active trips.
user_flows: Navigate to a ride detail page -> Review origin, destination, departure time, and driver information -> Select the number of seats -> Review the computed fare -> Confirm the booking
Navigate to an active ride tracking page -> View the live map of the driver’s location

features.name: Passenger Bookings
features.description: Lets passengers view and manage their own bookings by status.
user_flows: Navigate to /bookings -> Review bookings by status -> Open a booking detail -> Add seats to the booking
Navigate to /bookings -> Review bookings by status -> Open a booking detail -> Cancel the booking

features.name: Passenger Loyalty
features.description: Displays loyalty points, transaction history, and redeemable rewards for passengers.
user_flows: Navigate to /loyalty -> View points balance -> Review transaction history -> Browse the redemption catalog
Navigate to /loyalty -> Browse the redemption catalog -> Choose a reward -> Redeem the selected catalog item

features.name: Ratings and Reports
features.description: Shows the user’s rating summary and allows rating or reporting the other party after a completed booking.
user_flows: Navigate to /ratings -> View average rating and received comments
Navigate to a completed booking rating page -> Select a star rating -> Enter an optional comment -> Submit the rating
Navigate to a completed booking rating page -> Submit a report against the counterpart

features.name: Public User Profile
features.description: Displays another user’s public profile and rating summary.
user_flows: Navigate to a user profile page -> View display name, avatar, and rating summary

features.name: Account Settings
features.description: Lets users edit profile details, upload a profile photo, switch language, and sign out from settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/profile -> Edit display name and phone number -> Save the changes
Navigate to /settings/profile -> Upload a new profile photo -> Save the profile update
Navigate to /settings/profile -> Switch the interface language between English and Arabic -> Continue using the app

features.name: Groups
features.description: Allows users to browse, create, join, and manage carpool groups, including sponsored groups.
user_flows: Navigate to /groups -> Browse public groups -> Open a group detail page -> View members and rides
Navigate to /groups/create -> Enter group details -> Create the group -> See the new group detail page
Navigate to a group detail page -> Generate an invite link -> Share the invite link with others
Navigate to /groups/join/[inviteToken] -> Join a group via invite link -> Enter the required domain verification code if prompted -> Complete membership
Navigate to a group detail page -> Leave the group
Navigate to a group detail page as the owner -> Remove a member -> Transfer ownership -> Delete the group

features.name: Sponsorship Dashboard
features.description: Shows funding balance and spending breakdown for a sponsored group organizer.
user_flows: Navigate to /sponsorship-dashboard/[groupId] -> View funded balance -> Review spend breakdown by ride and member
Navigate to /sponsorship-dashboard/[groupId] -> Export the dashboard data

features.name: Driver Ride Management
features.description: Lets drivers post, edit, start, complete, cancel, and manage bookings for rides.
user_flows: Navigate to /rides -> View posted rides -> Start creating a new ride -> Pin the origin and destination on the map -> Set departure time and available seats -> Review the computed fare -> Submit the ride
Navigate to /rides/[id]/edit -> Edit the ride details within the allowed window -> Save the updated ride
Navigate to /rides/[id]/manage -> Start the ride -> Complete the ride
Navigate to /rides/[id]/manage -> Cancel the ride
Navigate to /rides/[id]/bookings -> Review pending bookings -> Confirm a passenger booking -> Reject a passenger booking

features.name: Recurring Rides
features.description: Lets drivers create weekly ride patterns and manage the generated instances.
user_flows: Navigate to /rides/recurring -> Select days of the week and a departure time -> Submit the recurring ride pattern
Navigate to /rides/recurring -> Open a recurring series -> View generated ride instances -> End the series

features.name: Driver Wallet
features.description: Displays the driver wallet balance, savings progress, and transaction history.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet -> View wallet balance -> Review car-maintenance-savings progress
Navigate to /wallet/history -> Review wallet transaction history

features.name: Wallet Cash-Back Redemption
features.description: Lets drivers redeem accumulated cash-back from their wallet.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet/cash-back/redeem -> Enter a redeem amount -> Confirm redemption

features.name: Wallet Top-Up
features.description: Lets drivers submit and manage wallet top-up requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet/topup -> Review top-up limits and settings -> Enter an amount -> Upload payment proof -> Submit the top-up request
Navigate to /wallet/topup/history -> Review top-up request history and status
Navigate to /wallet/topup -> Review pending top-up requests -> Cancel a pending request

features.name: Wallet Withdrawal
features.description: Lets drivers submit and track wallet withdrawal requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet/withdraw -> Enter a withdrawal amount -> Provide payout details -> Submit the withdrawal request
Navigate to /wallet/withdraw/history -> Review withdrawal history and status

tech_stack: Supabase SSR/JS client (auth session, direct table reads from client)
Leaflet / react-leaflet (maps, live location, route pin-drop)

known_limitations.issue: Legacy ID/document verification pages are effectively unreachable through normal UI navigation
known_limitations.impact: National ID verification was legally removed as a product gate; the only in-app link to /verify-id and /driver/verify-documents (a TopBar badge) is feature-flagged off, and the onboarding profile page only redirects there if verification_status is already "rejected" from a legacy record. A crawler starting from a fresh disposable account will not find a UI path to these two routes.

known_limitations.issue: Passenger map/pin-drop search flow has no wired entry point yet
known_limitations.impact: The /search page defaults to a "landing" mode showing Featured Rides only; the map/pin-drop search form ("search" mode) is currently only reachable via a sessionStorage results-restore path, not a visible button, per an in-code comment noting the "Find a Ride" wiring is a later story.

known_limitations.issue: Ride creation redirects to vehicle registration if the driver has no active vehicle
known_limitations.impact: A test account attempting to reach the ride-creation form must first have an active registered vehicle, or it will be redirected to /driver/register-vehicle instead.

known_limitations.issue: Full app access requires org-email verification, not just sign-in
known_limitations.impact: Every authenticated route (all of them except /login, /otp, /signout) redirects to /verify-org-email until profiles.org_verified_at is set, and driver-only routes further redirect non-driver-role accounts to "/". The test account used must already have a completed profile (real display_name), an assigned role, and org_verified_at set, or the crawler will get stuck in onboarding instead of reaching feature pages.
